fail.summary: Mark cookies Secure so browsers never send them over plain HTTP.

generic: In your application or CMS settings, turn on secure cookies. For frameworks this is usually a setting such as SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE.
Add HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax (or Strict) at the same time.

warn.summary: Add HttpOnly and SameSite to the cookies listed.

generic: Set HttpOnly on cookies that scripts do not need to read, especially session cookies.
Set SameSite=Lax unless you need the cookie on cross-site requests.
Cookies set by third-party tools (analytics, chat) may not be under your control.
